title: LadderFitOptions
description: Shipping f32 working weights with f64 metric/feedback/search arithmetic.

damp.description: Finite, nonnegative damping relative to the mean input-Gram diagonal.

decay.description: Finite feedback fraction in `0..=1`; one is plain GPTQ.

decay_ramp.description: Ramp feedback from one to the configured fraction along the input axis.

grid.description: Quarter-octave anchor grid candidates per group; zero retains the legacy single guess.

LadderScaleRefit.description: Placement of the ladder scale refit, without changing its numerical policy.

oneOf.description: Refit during the post-feedback coordinate search.
Refit completed groups before propagating to the remaining columns.
